name: bite
pose: The two steel crusher jaws are completely closed in a hard bite impact pose, the four feet firmly braced. Compact mechanical force; no stretching of body. This is the attack IMPACT reference.
purpose: Single action reference only, never raster input to runtime animation

name: charge
pose: A low compressed anticipation pose before a leftward charge. Leg pistons bend slightly, chassis lowers, jaws nearly closed, four feet rooted. This is the DASH crouch key-pose reference.
purpose: Single action reference only, never raster input to runtime animation

name: slam
pose: The same machine in one mid-air tucked landing-preparation pose: all four short legs folded close under the same chassis, jaws open slightly. No floor, no takeoff effect. This is the JUMP/SLAM tuck key-pose reference.
purpose: Single action reference only, never raster input to runtime animation

name: stagger
pose: The same machine recoils as an overloaded clamp: four feet stay braced, front housing tilts upward only slightly, red inner furnace bright but no floating light effects. This is the STAGGER impact key-pose reference.
purpose: Single action reference only, never raster input to runtime animation
